title: Measure and deploy the gPTP ingress/egress timestamp-latency split

milestone.title: Instrument verification (2027)
milestone.description: Measurements that need an external instrument on the bench: an oscilloscope with a 1 PPS reference, and a PHY-boundary timestamp instrument. Everything that can be proven in simulation or from the fabric's own counters stays in the 2026 milestones.

body:
## Remaining objective

Measure and publish the per-board ingress/egress timestamp-latency split at the
PHY reference plane, then program exactly one owner of those corrections.

This ticket originally grouped four gPTP defects. Three are already delivered:

- [x] `PTP_INCR` reset derives from the real fabric clock frequency.
- [x] The software-era asCapable proxy was replaced by a leased real variable;
      the fabric gPTP migration is tracked by #110.
- [x] The staged AS_PATH store grew beyond the legacy two-entry shape.
- [ ] The ingress/egress latency split is measured and deployed.

## Why the remaining item is open

Peer-delay measurements reveal only the sum of ingress and egress latency. A
wrong split can leave peer delay looking correct while shifting the synchronized
clock by half the split error. The current 3511 ns Arty and 1490 ns AX7101
figures are sum-style bench calibrations, not a per-direction measurement.

The RTL correction plane is already live:

- `PTP_INGRESS_LAT` (`0x540`) is subtracted from RX captures.
- `PTP_EGRESS_LAT` (`0x544`) is added to TX captures.

The missing evidence requires observation at the GMII/PHY boundary; the current
AXIS-SOP capture point cannot determine the split by itself.

## Work

1. Define and record the PHY-boundary instrument and topology before measuring.
2. Measure the round-trip sum independently.
3. Derive a pipeline/PHY prior for each direction, then sweep the split while
   slaved to a certified peer and null the receive-timestamp-delta mean.
4. Record per-board constants, uncertainty, temperature/link-mode conditions,
   tool revisions, and raw captures.
5. Make one layer own the correction. Software configuration must carry zeros
   when the fabric registers own it, so the value cannot be applied twice.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The AX7101 has a reproducible ingress and egress measurement, not only a
      sum. (Owner decision 2026-09-27: ALINX only; Arty measurement is future work
      under #583.)
- [ ] Peer delay remains at the measured physical value after applying the
      split, and synchronized offset matches the local-clock baseline.
- [ ] Cold boot and ownership-transition tests prove the correction is never
      absent or double-applied.
- [ ] Board configuration, `TIME_SYNC.md`, the compliance matrix, and the
      register-map ownership note agree on the measured values and owner.

Related: #110 (fabric gPTP migration), #117 (one-DUT silicon qualification), #488 (instrumented measurements).

[A10] 2026-09-27: acceptance narrowed to the AX7101 by the owner's ALINX-only decision. The correction-plane description above predates the fabric gPTP constants and REQ-PTP-06. Re-state the current owner of the ingress/egress correction before measuring.
